rules.title: Source of truth
rules.body: For DHIKA: read the exact source text and episode-local line ranges in data/episodes/eXX.json. Do not treat AI summaries as primary evidence. For FWFS: reader-approved decisions outrank draft suggestions; preserve named actors, chronology and accepted events.

rules.title: Same encounter ≠ same response
rules.body: A similar ordinary scenario may recur, but each character enters with a different prior state, motivation, prior knowledge and consequence. Do not manufacture four identical reactions.

rules.title: Five interconnected state tracks
rules.body: Maintain Ankita, Shivani, Shreya, Tanya and Chirag/Chotu (22) as five parallel, accumulating character-state ledgers. Chotu's experiences carry over according to actual clock order, not display order.

rules.title: Entry → Middle → Exit
rules.body: Entry: practical reason, roles, immediate previous state. Middle: actor, affected person, witness, non-graphic action label, immediate reaction, knowledge gap, highest milestone. Exit: task outcome, separate private interpretation, next encounter dependency.

rules.title: Doer / Receiver / Observer
rules.body: Name who initiated, who was affected, who actually noticed, what everyone can infer, and what remains private. Body language is not proof of consent, reciprocation or another person's thoughts.

rules.title: Strong tension without generic filler
rules.body: Non-graphic direction must keep concrete anticipation, hesitation, proximity, choice and consequences where supported; avoid replacing action with vague soft emotional summaries. Do not generate graphic anatomy or sexual choreography in the director brief.

rules.title: Preservation-first change policy
rules.body: KEEP working paragraphs. PATCH supported causal gaps or definite errors. REWORK only broken story mechanics with reader approval. Keep rejected versions intact and keep separate Part 7 A/B candidates.

rules.title: Writer / Director / Reviewer
rules.body: Reader selects plot and approved deviations. ChatGPT checks primary sources, constructs coherent non-graphic scene architecture, and audits continuity. Grok authors prose from an exact approved brief and reports deviations; Grok output never self-approves.

rules.title: Correction publishing workflow
rules.body: New corrections are appended to this structured JSON register with IDs and statuses. After a repository commit, the Story Lab review UI refreshes to show the updated register. This static reader UI cannot edit GitHub by itself.
